faqs.question: Is 😚🌹 flirty on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 😚🌹 shows up in comment threads, captions, and duet replies. The flirty register is the same as on iMessage — most viewers read the cue as sincere attraction.

faqs.question: Does 😚🌹 mean love?
faqs.answer: 😚🌹 sits between attraction and love. The flirting-coded cue is closer to attraction than to the deep-coded meaning of 💞 or 💕, so most readers treat it as soft-coded interest rather than love.

faqs.question: Is 😚🌹 appropriate for work?
faqs.answer: Skip 😚🌹 in work channels. The flirting-coded cue is the wrong register for professional threads unless the relationship with the recipient is explicitly non-work.

faqs.question: What does 😚🌹 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 😚🌹 shows up in DMs and under flirty photo comments. The flirting cue reads best in 1:1 threads where the relationship is already on the flirted side.
